title: total_debt concept misses captive finance for Ford-like companies
description: Ford total_debt resolves to $291M via DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount or LongTermDebt. Actual consolidated debt is ~$162B, dominated by Ford Motor Credit. The narrow GAAP tags miss finance subsidiary borrowings. This cascades into handspread: Ford EV = $18B instead of ~$200B, EV/Revenue = 0.1x instead of ~1.0x. Reproduce: edgarpack query F total_debt --period ltm. Potential fix: add broader debt concepts like LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations or DebtLongTermAndShortTermCombinedAmount. May need special handling for companies with captive finance arms (F, GM, CAT, DE).

title: Support LTM-1 (prior-year LTM) period queries
description: Currently edgarpack supports period=ltm which computes LTM from the most recent stub. Handspread needs LTM-1 (prior-year equivalent LTM) to compute TTM growth rates instead of annual growth rates. Example: if LTM is Nov 2024 - Oct 2025, LTM-1 should be Nov 2023 - Oct 2024. Implementation: extend the comps() function to accept period=ltm-1 or return both LTM and LTM-1 in a single call. The stub math is the same (MRP + LFY - MRP_prior) but shifted back one year. Requires pulling one additional year of quarterly XBRL data from companyfacts.
design: Spec: docs/ROBUSTNESS-SPEC-2026-02-17.md. Implemented shared LTM engine with year-shifted anchor, added period=ltm-1 routing, kept graceful fallback to anchored reported value when prior-year components are missing, and preserved citation/component provenance for LTM-family outputs.
notes: Code: query/periods.py, query/models.py, query/financials.py, cli.py, docs + tests. Validation: ruff check . && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (200 passed).
close_reason: LTM-1 tests added, SBC concept mapping added, docs polished

title: 20-F annual filers show 0% LTM growth (LTM = LTM-1)
description: Companies filing only annually (20-F filers like TSM and BABA) have no quarterly data. Both LTM and LTM-1 resolve to the same last fiscal year value, producing 0% growth. TSM grew ~30% and BABA grew ~5%, but the system shows 0%. Reproduce: edgarpack comps TSM BABA --metrics revenue --period ltm, then compare to ltm-1. Fix: when no quarterly data exists, LTM-1 should fall back to FY(N-1) while LTM falls back to FY(N), giving FY-over-FY growth instead of nothing.
